SEARCH
Package com.jpexs.decompiler.graph

Class Graph

java.lang.Object
com.jpexs.decompiler.graph.Graph
Direct Known Subclasses:
ActionGraph, AVM2Graph
public class Graph extends Object
Graph class. This is the main class where decompilation process is done. It translates GraphSourceItems to GraphTargetItems.

Subclasses of Graph are used for different types of decompilation.

Author:
JPEXS
